name: Five Years
source:
Logan was doing well in life. He even won a community soccer league! That's when he met Justin. Logan loved Justin. 

But a lot can happen in Five Years. 

[From [url=https://bigbearentertainment.itch.io/five-years]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
洛根的日子过得不错，甚至还拿过一次社区足球联赛的冠军！那就是他遇见贾斯汀的时候。洛根爱贾斯汀。

但五年里可以发生很多事。
